source_policy: Auxiliary tasks use train.csv only; remove target holdout scaffolds and all target official valid/test scaffolds from auxiliary data during fitting; also remove heldout canonical molecules. Final target fit can use target train+valid, but auxiliary source rows still come only from train.csv and exclude target test scaffolds.
selection: Complete predetermined candidate pool per task, reconstruct exact v7 OOF baseline, choose once on reused train scaffold OOF; lock family and alpha before official valid; no runner-up retries after rejection
objective: mean primary gain minus half fold standard deviation
notes: Multi-scale kernel adds radius-3 4096-count Morgan, binary ECFP and feature/path/atom-pair/descriptor views. Fixed two-C ensemble; no validation hyperparameter tuning.
Spearman target uses a fit-only Gaussian rank transform and monotonic empirical inverse. MAE uses a fit-only robust center and scale.
Task-conditional gated multi-view neural network trains target and related assays jointly, with shared experts, private task branches and train-only preprocessing.
No external assay data, no test labels, no test-label lookup. No automatic competition submission.
Official valid, three OOF folds and repeated scaffold split have historical reuse; results are selection-biased robustness checks, not untouched test estimates.
Use v7 predictions unchanged for every rejected task. Unknown scoring formula precludes reliable platform score projection.
Do not weaken gates or add candidates after inspecting official validation failures within this protocol. A later iteration needs a separately versioned protocol.
